more_info.overview: Potassium fumarate is a potassium salt of fumaric acid, identified by JECFA for acidity control. Its acidity-control function is to adjust or maintain food pH. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
